name: Momose Tamaki
source:
Agirlwhohelps[url=/c11648]Toby[/url],ashady street vendor.with his work. She’s the quiet type who has a hard time standing up for herself.She likes Kenji Miyazawa's [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Night_on_the_Galactic_Railroad]Ginga Tetsudou no Yoru[/url].

Tamaki's school is located far away from her home... Why did she even move to this area?


  Translated from the[url=http://memoriesoff.jp/psp/omokimi/chara.html]Official Site[/url].]
